name: GitHub Actions Runner
author: hey@vudira.com
description: Self-hosted GitHub Actions runner using GitHub's official actions-runner image (ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner:latest). The install script copies the runner bundled at /home/runner inside the image into /mnt/server/actions-runner, registers it against REPO_URL with REG_TOKEN, and chowns the directory to UID 988 so the runtime container (which Pterodactyl runs as the "container" user) can launch it.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo '[install] Using the official GitHub actions-runner image.'

# Clean any stale install from a previous server lifetime.
rm -rf /mnt/server/actions-runner
mkdir -p /mnt/server/actions-runner

# The official image ships the runner pre-extracted at /home/runner. Because the
# install container is built from that same image, we can copy it straight into
# the persistent volume instead of downloading a fresh tarball.
if [ -d /home/runner ] && [ -f /home/runner/config.sh ]; then
    echo '[install] Copying bundled runner from /home/runner to /mnt/server/actions-runner'
    cp -a /home/runner/. /mnt/server/actions-runner/
else
    echo '[install] Bundled runner not found at /home/runner - downloading v2.329.0 instead'
    cd /mnt/server/actions-runner
    curl -fsSL -o actions-runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v2.329.0/actions-runner-linux-x64-2.329.0.tar.gz
    echo '194f1e1e4bd02f80b7e9633fc546084d8d4e19f3928a324d512ea53430102e1d  actions-runner.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
    tar -xzf actions-runner.tar.gz
    rm -f actions-runner.tar.gz
fi

cd /mnt/server/actions-runner

FLAGS=(--unattended --url "$REPO_URL" --token "$REG_TOKEN" --work _work --replace)
[ -n "${RUNNER_NAME:-}" ]   && FLAGS+=(--name "$RUNNER_NAME")
[ -n "${RUNNER_LABELS:-}" ] && FLAGS+=(--labels "$RUNNER_LABELS")
[ -n "${RUNNER_GROUP:-}" ]  && FLAGS+=(--runnergroup "$RUNNER_GROUP")

echo '[install] Registering runner via config.sh'
./config.sh "${FLAGS[@]}"

# Pterodactyl runs the runtime container as UID 988 ("container"), but the
# bundled runner files are owned by UID 1001 ("runner"). Re-own everything so
# run.sh can write to _diag, _work, .credentials, etc. at runtime.
echo '[install] Re-owning runner directory to UID 988 for the Pterodactyl container user'
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server/actions-runner

echo '[install] Configuration complete. Startup will execute: cd /home/container/actions-runner && ./run.sh'

variables.name: Repository URL
variables.description: GitHub repository or organization URL the runner should attach to (e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo or https://github.com/my-org).

variables.name: Registration Token
variables.description: Ephemeral registration token from GitHub (Settings > Actions > Runners > New self-hosted runner). Tokens expire after ~1 hour and are only used during initial registration.

variables.name: Runner Name
variables.description: Optional explicit runner name shown in the GitHub UI. Leave blank to auto-generate.

variables.name: Runner Labels
variables.description: Optional comma-separated extra labels for the runner (e.g. self-hosted,linux,x64,pterodactyl).

variables.name: Runner Group
variables.description: Optional GitHub runner group name. Leave blank to use the repository's default group.
